auth.v1.GetNonceRequest.description:
GetNonceRequest requests a short-lived login nonce for a smart-account
 address. The wallet must sign a message containing this nonce before login.

smartAccountAddress.description: Smart-account EVM address, formatted as 0x plus 40 hex characters.
smartAccountAddress.title: smart_account_address

auth.v1.GetNonceRequest.title: GetNonceRequest

auth.v1.GetNonceResponse.description: GetNonceResponse contains the nonce that must be signed for wallet login.

expiresAt.description: Time in UTC when the nonce expires. Login nonces expire after 5 minutes.
expiresAt.title: expires_at

nonce.description:
Random login nonce. The nonce is single-purpose and is replaced by each new
 nonce request for the same smart-account address.
nonce.title: nonce

auth.v1.GetNonceResponse.title: GetNonceResponse

auth.v1.LoginWithWalletRequest.description:
LoginWithWalletRequest completes smart-account wallet login using a signed
 nonce.

ip.description:
Optional caller IP address for account security and audit displays. Maximum
 length is 64 characters.
ip.title: ip

nonce.description: Nonce returned by GetNonce. The nonce must be unused and not expired.
nonce.title: nonce

primaryWalletAddress.description:
Optional primary wallet address that controls this smart account, formatted
 as 0x plus 40 hex characters. This value is metadata and is not used for
 signature verification.
primaryWalletAddress.title: primary_wallet_address

signature.description:
Signature over the canonical login message containing the nonce. Maximum
 length is 8192 characters to support universal wallet signatures.
signature.title: signature

smartAccountAddress.description:
Smart-account EVM address that produced the signature, formatted as 0x plus
 40 hex characters.
smartAccountAddress.title: smart_account_address

userAgent.description:
Optional user-agent string for account security and audit displays. Maximum
 length is 512 characters.
userAgent.title: user_agent

walletProvider.description: Optional provider hint for the primary wallet. Maximum length is 32 characters.
walletProvider.title: wallet_provider

auth.v1.LoginWithWalletRequest.title: LoginWithWalletRequest

auth.v1.LoginWithWalletResponse.description:
LoginWithWalletResponse returns a session token for the authenticated root
 account.

accessToken.description: Bearer access token for authenticated API calls.
accessToken.title: access_token

accountId.description: Root account the token is bound to (opaque ID).
accountId.title: account_id

expiresAt.description: Time in UTC when access_token expires.
expiresAt.title: expires_at

session.description: Session assurance details for the issued access token.
session.title: session

username.description: Optional current username for the root account (empty if not set).
username.title: username

auth.v1.LoginWithWalletResponse.title: LoginWithWalletResponse

auth.v1.MeResponse.description: MeResponse describes the authenticated caller and current session context.

apiKeyId.description: When present, indicates the request is authenticated via an API key.
apiKeyId.title: api_key_id

rootSmartAccountAddress.description:
Root smart-account EVM address, formatted as 0x plus 40 hex characters.
 Empty if not set.
rootSmartAccountAddress.title: root_smart_account_address

session.description: Session assurance details for the presented access token, if any.
session.title: session

username.description: Optional current username for the root account (empty if not set).
username.title: username

auth.v1.MeResponse.title: MeResponse

info.description:
Public trading API for market makers and integrators.
Connect RPC over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 with JSON and Protobuf.
info.title: Polyester API

post.description: Verify a signed wallet nonce and issue an access token for the caller account.

get.description: Retrieve the caller auth context, including account identity, API key identity, and session assurance details.

post.description: Retrieve a short-lived nonce for wallet-signature login.
